text_block_list.text:
"—The St. Lite Kinen (GII).
One of the trial races for the Kikuka Sho,
held at Nakayama Racecourse."
Naturally, it's a race with many formidable Umamusume, but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, watch me!
Today, Turbo's gonna make everyone jump
with her new running style!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's show 'em what we've got!

text_block_list.text:
In this high-profile race, Twin Turbo was poised
to showcase the running style forged in Fukushima.
But how will it play out...?

How far can it carry her on Nakayama Racecourse's large outer loop?
And on top of that—

"The opponents are top contenders for the Kikuka Sho.
Among them are several Umamusume who could become formidable rivals, but—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well then, it's about time to head into the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Now, where is that totally rad gal
I'm feeling such mega-destiny with...? Let's see."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh? If I recall...
You're Turbo-chan's Trainer, right?

This Umamusume is Maruzensky.
She's a high-spirited, trendy Umamusume who exudes
Bubble-era vibes and cruises around in a supercar.
Apparently, they came to cheer on their favorite Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the race. I don't think
my favorite girl could ever slip up,
but still~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You gotta watch out for Umamusume riding high on summer vibes.
Sometimes girls will suddenly act all grown up out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Turbo-chan... doesn't seem to have grown up at all. But...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Is it just my imagination?
I feel like I've gotten a little wilder...

Maruzensky senses an aura of danger.
Let's believe that her premonition is right on the mark.
